title: Olentangy School District Employee Salaries (2025)
description:
Gross pay for 4,238 employees of Olentangy Local School District (Delaware and Franklin Counties, Ohio) for calendar year 2025, published as an analysis-ready dataset alongside the Dagster pipeline that produces it.

The district's published position field packs multiple jobs into one delimited string; this dataset splits it into a role-level table and extracts contracted days per year, while leaving pay figures exactly as published. Employee names are removed. No job families, pay bands or rankings are imposed — several district payroll codes (CMF, CLAS-NON, LT-PLCMT, UNIV-PLA) have no published key and are passed through verbatim rather than guessed at.

Derived from The Columbus Dispatch's central Ohio public payroll database, obtained by them through a public records request. Gross pay includes overtime, stipends, holiday and accrued time, and is not contracted salary.
